---
title: "The Paradigm Shift Toward Embodied AI"
subtitle: "HSS118 Future Literacy, Week 2"
author: "Yunsung Lee"
institute: "DGIST, 2026-09-04"
# The title gradient is a reveal background so it fills the viewport at any
# aspect ratio; the theme drops its own section gradient when this is set.
title-slide-attributes:
  data-background-gradient: "linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #E8EDF5 100%)"
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: [default, ../../clean-academic.scss]
    # _fixtures/ is underscore-prefixed, so Quarto treats it as OUTSIDE the
    # project: Quarto/_quarto.yml defaults, the filter and the font link do NOT
    # apply here and are repeated below. Real decks under Quarto/<genre>/
    # inherit them from _quarto.yml and set none of this.
    width: 1280
    height: 720
    margin: 0
    center: false
    auto-stretch: false
    slide-number: true
    html-math-method:
      method: katex
      url: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.11/dist/"
    filters:
      - ../../_filters/slide-types.lua
    include-in-header:
      - text: '<link rel="stylesheet" href="../../fonts/pretendard.css">'
---

{{< include body.qmd >}}
